tagline.en: Skywork's 14B reference-to-video model — generates video guided by a reference image, with audio and video-to-video routes.
tagline.zh: Skywork 的 14B 参考图生视频模型——以参考图引导生成视频,并支持音频与视频到视频路径。

en: SkyReels V3 is Skywork's video generation model, released here as the 14B reference-to-video (R2V) checkpoint. It generates video guided by a reference image, using dual text-and-image conditioning so both a prompt and a reference shape the output.

Beyond reference-to-video, its tasks span audio-guided video and video-to-video generation. Under the hood it builds on a Wan-style network with a UMT5 text conditioner, a latent codec, and a UniPC scheduler, and it loads directly into the shared native graph.
In WorldFoundry, SkyReels V3 runs through the shared diffusion runner — provide a reference image and prompt (and, for the relevant routes, audio or a source video), and it renders a clip.
zh: SkyReels V3 是 Skywork 的视频生成模型,此处以 14B 参考图生视频(R2V)checkpoint 发布。它以参考图引导生成视频,采用文本与图像双重条件,让提示词和参考图共同塑造输出。
除参考图生视频外,它的任务还涵盖音频引导视频与视频到视频生成。其内部构建在 Wan 风格网络之上,配有 UMT5 文本条件模块、latent 编解码器与 UniPC 调度器,并直接加载到共享的原生图中。
在 WorldFoundry 中,SkyReels V3 通过共享扩散 runner 运行——提供参考图与提示词(相应路径下再加音频或源视频),它就渲染出片段。

whenToUse.en: Use SkyReels V3 when you want video generation anchored to a reference image, or need audio-guided or video-to-video routes in one model.
whenToUse.zh: 当你想让视频生成锚定到一张参考图,或需要在一个模型里使用音频引导或视频到视频路径时,可以使用 SkyReels V3。

notFor.en: The reference-to-video route expects a reference image, so it isn't a pure prompt-only generator. At 14B, plan for adequate GPU memory.
notFor.zh: 参考图生视频路径需要一张参考图,因此它不是纯提示词生成器。14B 规模请预留充足的显存。
